program.objective: Preserve DRD2 affinity and CNS exposure while improving solubility and hERG safety. Keep affinity above the programme floor.
program.activity_strategy: DRD2 activity is represented by similarity to a reference panel of known DRD2 ligands. This is a structural proxy, not an affinity model.
